name: Top Out: Skyscraper Climb
summary: Climb an unfinished skyscraper in VR. Sprint up steep ramps, inch along steel beams, swing across monkey bars and grab wet-paint holds before they slip from your hands. Work your way up 60 floors of bare concrete and steel, the city far below, until you stand on top of the antenna mast, 265 meters above the street. Race the clock for gold or hunt for hidden trophies. Just don't look down.
